before_action.short_description: Creating a qualified investor security-clearance pilot for defense technology
before_action.compact_description: The failed amendment would require a pilot but retain discretionary participation, lawful need-to-know, facility-or-alternative security and other safeguards. No foreign cleared professional, personal-gain use or preferred Federal award is authorized. Reports begin1yearfromenactment; authority sunsets5yearsfromenactment unless reauthorized. Whole technology-versus-investment/security membership remains unaccepted.
before_action.meaning:
The House rejected exact PartA30to H.R.8800, the national-security investor personnel-clearance pilot. The whole proposed section would require the Secretary, acting through DCSA, to establish a pilot supporting investment in qualifying national-security technology companies. Rejection did not add this section to the bill, grant a clearance, prefer a particular investor or certify a company.
Establishment SHALL occur under the proposal, while participation approval and investor sponsorship are discretionary and subject to Secretary approval. A sponsored clearance could be maintained independently of a specific Federal contract only while the investor remains eligible. Access to classified information requires a LAWFUL NEED-TO-KNOW and applicable security procedures; the pilot is not unrestricted classified access or a waiver of all clearance requirements. Authorized uses are solely the listed diligence, development/scaling/commercialization, Federal engagement, company support and authorization-assistance purposes.
An eligible investor must be a UnitedStatesperson/entity providing the listed investment support, NOT owned, controlled or influenced by a foreign person, with the specified relevant technology history and additional Secretary-prescribed requirements. Covered companies are USsmallbusinessconcerns under the incorporated632definition or Secretary-designated medium businesses developing/producing/commercializing relevant technology/products/services. The retained632(a)(1)unit supplies only the general independently-owned/operated and not-dominant definition; other SBA size/program rules, foreign-person determinations and individual eligibility are not certified. Investor representatives qualify as cleared professionals only after being granted a clearance under the section. No foreign person may serve in that role.
Each participating investor must maintain a FACILITY CLEARANCE OR Secretary-approved ALTERNATIVE SECURITY ARRANGEMENT, and comply with industrial-security, insider-threat and reporting requirements. The Secretary MAY suspend or revoke participation for security violations or foreign-ownership/control/influence concerns. Classified access may not be used for personal financial gain, securities trading, market manipulation or unrelated purposes. Those printed restrictions coexist with the listed investment-support purposes; this candidate does not adjudicate permissible profit or an individual transaction. Participation provides NO PREFERENCE in Federal contracts, grants or assistance. No numerical participation cap is imposed by this section; that is not automatic approval or guaranteed funding.
The first congressional-defense-committee report would be due one year AFTER ENACTMENT and annually thereafter, describing participation, clearances, supported companies, measured impacts, incidents/concerns and recommendations. Required impact reporting is not proof of actual innovation, manufacturing or security results. Authority under this section terminates five years AFTER ENACTMENT unless reauthorized by law; the text does not revoke every clearance authorized under other law. Current clearance regulations, security implementation and individual company/investor classifications remain uninspected.
An Aye would support this whole conditional pilot; a No opposes it without a component-specific position. Infrastructure/Technology membership is an UNACCEPTED candidate proposal based on expressly supporting national-security technology development and commercialization through qualified security-clearance sponsorship. A competing boundary treats the whole choice as investment/security-personnel administration. Independent whole-version, security/baseline and taxonomy review is required. No clearance award, unrestricted disclosure, preferred contract, actual investment/innovation/security result, wrongdoing, motive or enactment is inferred.
limitations: Failed exactPartA30, not an enacted pilot, clearance award, funding guarantee or preferred contractor.

Facilityclearance OR approvedalternative; FOCI/security suspension discretionary and no foreignclearedprofessional.
No personalfinancialgain/trading/manipulation/unrelateduse or Federalaward preference; no adjudication of permissible investment profit.
One-yearreport/annualrecurrence and five-yearauthoritysunset fromENACTMENT; no numericalcap doesnotguaranteeapproval.
Only632(a)(1)generaldefinition retained; otherSBA/security/foreignperson/currenteligibility rules uncertified; taxonomy unaccepted.
